svg.title: Vectis Concepts – Educational Universe Board
svg.desc: Layered production SVG created to match the established Vectis Concepts featured concept assets. Major visual regions are isolated as named Inkscape-compatible layers; illustrated details remain embedded raster artwork to preserve the approved appearance.
